name: Multi-View Splatting Pipeline with Fill-Rate Filtering
definition: A rendering pipeline that generates multi-view 2D images from a 3D point cloud, filters out sparse views based on fill rate, and saves structured outputs.
summary: Multi-View Splatting Pipeline with Fill-Rate Filtering generates multi-view 2D images from 3D point clouds by rasterizing points as splats and filtering views based on pixel coverage density to ensure structured output quality.
